subject: is it possible to write vcf file from dartseq data in dartR

messages.author: 72c8cb07efefb0ec
messages.subject: is it possible to write vcf file from dartseq data in dartR
parts:
Hi 
I am trying to produce dadi software input file (demographic analysis using allele frequency spectrum) import from my dart-seq data, but I cant find a way in dartR or other common popgene analysis R packages. Since dadi can read vcf format, is there a way to write  (convert) vcf file from gl, gi SNP data?
Thanks a million in advance
Farhad

by the way the input format of SNP for dadi is as below;
SNP      Allele1 n-pop1  n-pop2  n-pop3  allele2 n-pop1  n-pop2  n-pop3  Gene    Position
SNP1A/G  T     27  22  43   G   3   2   a   1
SNP2C/T  C     27  22  43   T   3   2   a   2
SNP3C/T  C     29  24  44   T   1   0   a   3
SNP4C/T  C     30  24  44   T   0   0   a   4
SNP5A/G  A     3   2   1       G   27  22  a   5

                                    
            #"n= number of times allele 1 was observed in that population"   
                         # pop= population, gene and position are arbitrary columns
